limitations: The source is a user-provided secondary biography; its historical claims were not independently fact-checked.
Semantic structuring was produced by Codex and is labeled model_predicted; no external extraction provider was used.
Ten representative higher-order themes were selected for renderer testing and are not an exhaustive extraction of the document.

The late-life trajectory is modeled as three evidence-linked event hyperedges over atomic person, time, and place nodes; trajectory_index metadata records chronology and does not create directed edges or composite stage nodes.
This bundle contains no native pairwise relation, so the renderer omits the pairwise view and creates no projection auxiliary nodes.
